body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: c4e96ead0de78a4db0921e2bc4c715d1ca96ee71 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers found on head c4e96ead; it trial-merges cleanly with current main.

**What looks good**
- Project file: the `theme` key is no longer written and an older file that carries it still opens (`project_roundtrip::the_project_file_never_carries_the_theme_and_an_old_theme_key_is_ignored`, four older shapes). No version bump, and no older build is broken: the key was optional.
- Prefs file: resolved through `recent::config_dir_for` (per-OS env, `CAMCRAFT_CONFIG_DIR`), written atomically via `write_atomic`. Missing, corrupt, foreign-format or unknown-value files fall back to defaults with a named reason, never a panic (`crates/app/src/prefs.rs`).
- Tests never touch the real prefs file: headless `State` has no store (`crates/ui/src/state_prefs.rs`), and `prefs_door` uses a temp dir.
- Undo: `SetTheme` / `SetColorVision` are gone from the history on purpose, as the decision file says. `ribbon_pins.rs` only had a doc comment touched and stays undoable.
- No MCP tool referenced the theme command (no `SetTheme` / `SetColorVision` hits in `crates/`).
- Process files are unchanged against main (`PROCESS_VERSION` 14, no bump needed). No Cargo, build.rs, scripts or `.github` changes.
- The `expect` / `unwrap` calls added by the PR are all inside test code. The UI diagnostic goes through `diag_warn!`.

**Local results (trial merge with origin/main, head c4e96ead)**

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app --test view_prefs` | 6 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app --test project_roundtrip` | 71 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app --test commands_undo` | 30 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`, includes `prefs_door`) | 530 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean, exit 0 |

The earlier `diag` lint failure (#907) is not present on this merged tree.

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (non-blocking)**
1. `crates/ui/src/state_prefs.rs` `persist_prefs`: a failed save is logged but the status line says nothing, so a read-only config folder looks like a working pick until restart. Consider surfacing the save error in `self.status`.
2. A corrupt `prefs.json` is replaced by the next pick. This is probably right, but the status note at startup is the only warning the user gets.
3. Prefs are written synchronously on the UI thread at each pick. It is one small file, so this is fine.
4. macOS, Linux and wasm were not exercised (noted in the body); the folder resolver is #662's.
5. `crates/ui/src/state.rs` shrinks (4288 to 4246 lines) and `schema.rs` shrinks (558 to 556). No file is pushed past the ~400-line guideline by this PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
